## Download

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows (installer, recommended)** | `osu-collect-setup-x64.exe`: installs osu!collect for your user (no admin rights), adds Start menu and desktop shortcuts that open the web interface, and registers an uninstaller |
| Windows (portable) | `osu-collect-windows-x64.exe` |
| Linux x64 | `osu-collect-linux-x64` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `osu-collect-macos-arm64` |

SHA-256 checksums are attached as `.sha256` files and `SHA256SUMS`.

## What's new

### Web interface
- `osu-collect web` (or the **osu!collect** shortcut on Windows) opens a local web app in your browser: paste an osu!collector link, preview the collection with covers, pick a folder and follow every download live.
- Settings page for mirrors (drag to reorder), parallel downloads, videos, skipping maps you already have and your osu! install. It uses the same config file as the terminal app.
- Themes: dark, light, **Lazer** (inspired by osu!lazer, with drifting triangles) and system; six accent colours; English and French.
- Interface sounds and animations, both of which can be turned off. Animations also follow the system's reduced-motion setting.

### Faster downloads
- Mirrors are chosen by measured speed, and load is spread across them.
- Slow or silent mirrors are dropped mid-transfer when another mirror is available.
- Instant failover on mirror errors, no blocking size probe, buffered disk writes and connection reuse.
- More parallel downloads by default (2 × CPU cores, between 12 and 24).
- On the bundled offline benchmark: **2.9× faster** at 8 parallel downloads (29.9 s → 10.3 s).

### Other
- New logo and app icon.
- Self-update now follows this repository's releases.
